verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform and its developer skills, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage analytics, or any opt-out control for Sprinto's platform or its compliance-skills tooling. The PII-detection and GDPR features are about scanning customer codebases, not about Sprinto's own data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
